Logistics matter just as much: we position live grills and carving stations with safe clearance, cook in waves so food arrives hot instead of sitting under lamps, and station staff to keep the buffet replenished through the evening. For hosts who want a luxury UAE National Day experience, we add a dedicated Arabic coffee and dates station, a live luqaimat counter, and an oud-scented majlis setup that turns dinner into the centrepiece of the celebration.

new_paragraphs: How much does UAE National Day catering cost in Dubai?

What is included in UAE National Day catering?

Everything from menu design to the final clean-up. We handle the menu, the chef, the service team, the plating, setup and full cleanup — you host the celebration and we run the food operation end to end.
What food is on a UAE National Day menu?

Emirati and Arabic mains anchor it — majlis-style mezze, charcoal grills, machboos and ouzi over aromatic rice, and sweets like luqaimat and kunafa. Every menu is bespoke and tailored to your taste, guests and dietary needs.
Can you cater corporate UAE National Day events?
Yes — corporate UAE National Day catering in Dubai is one of our busiest formats. We plan office majlis spreads, buffets and live stations around a working schedule for teams of any size.
Is the Emirati catering halal?
Yes. Our Emirati and Arabic menus are prepared halal as standard, with vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free options labelled at each station so every guest can choose with confidence.
How far ahead should I book?
A week is usually enough for a small gathering. Book earlier for large parties and the 2 December peak, when popular dates and chefs fill quickly.
Which areas of Dubai do you cover?

All of Dubai — villas in Jumeirah, Palm Jumeirah and Emirates Hills, apartments in Dubai Marina and Business Bay, and offices in Downtown and DIFC. Wherever you are hosting, the same vetted team delivers.
For uae national day catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
